name: Sesame-Crusted Sweet & Sour Tofu with Jasmine Rice (Night 2)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · Animator's Palate (Animation Magic Night 2)
searchKeywords: sesame crusted sweet and sour tofu
whyItWorks: Firm soy tofu and steamed jasmine rice are gentle plant proteins, though the sesame seed crust and sweet-and-sour peppers need trimming.
